TEXT:
[FI] Judging from the results, it does seem like 
everything will be fine.
[FI] If you want to know why, it's because this beach...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=33]There's no one else here![/font_size]
[FI] Completely devoid of people.
[FI] Saori... I knew she was rich, but...
[FI] I never expected she would own a private beach...
[FI] She's like some princess from a manga.

[FI] Well, there's no way a bunch of people could see 
her in a swimsuit here, that's for certain.
[FI] This could get rid of some of her embarrassment.
[FI] But-

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Saori in a swimsuit, huh.
[FI] I can't even imagine it.

[FI] Even though she's revealed her true self, the only 
"Saori" that comes to my mind is the one in the 
spiral glasses.

[FI] Like when she wore the maid outfit with the glasses 
on-

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Hahahaha! How is it!? Sexy, no!
[FI] So yeah, nothing but that comes to mind.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] ...Well, once the real thing appears, that will probably 
be overwritten.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...She's really slow.
[FI] I'm tired of waiting.

[FI] Suddenly, I felt someone's eyes on the back of my 
neck.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ?
[FI] Was that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...That girl.
[FI] I think I get what's going on.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Isn't it about time you come out now?
[FI] I directed my voice towards her hiding spot.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...Urgh.
[FI] Sure enough, Lady Saori appeared in her swimsuit.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...I-I knew it... It's embarrassing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I thought this would happen.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You could have just put on a jacket.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...I can't do that.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] We've come all the way to the beach, so if we don't 
swim...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] And besides...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] T-Thou were looking forward to thy swimsuit, right?
[FI] It looks like she's started to act like Bajeena, but...
[FI] Without those glasses, it's not working out.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Haha, yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] But, are you sure you're okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You were talking about dying just from holding 
hands, and now you're suddenly wearing a 
swimsuit.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] He...hehe... I'm about to die right now as well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No good then.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] In any case, if I can't handle this much 
embarrassment... I can't... date a gentleman like you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I see.
[FI] Geez... She really is a hard worker.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] M-More importantly...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] How is it, my swimsuit!

[FI] To hide her embarrassment, she asked me with 
great vigor.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Th-That's quite a bold swimsuit there...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...I prepared it just for today though?
[FI] Looks like it's my turn to be embarrassed.
[FI] Because...
[FI] I can't believe she just got into high school.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] ...Do you have the same measurements as a certain 
Fujiko?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=33]!?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] G-Geez! Just where are you looking!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] S-Sorry.
[FI] I've clearly chosen the wrong thing to say.

[FI] Instead, I should've said something more suitable 
like, "It looks good on you." or, "It's cute."
[FI] But you know what? Hear me out.
[FI] If you're presented with such a view-
[FI] Holy cow! Her breasts are huge!

[FI] And if your mind isn't filled with similar thoughts, 
you can't call yourself a man.

[FI] The completely embarrassed Saori stood there and 
muttered,

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=18]...I-It's the same.[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] They're the same as a certain Norika-san! A-Are you 
satisfied!
[FI] She talks weird when she gets mad.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] R-Right. I see!

[FI] It might be that she's angry, but she doesn't look 
that nervous now. So Saori suggested...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Come, let's do our warm-up and go swimming.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You can swim?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Not as well as my sister, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] When it comes to sports, I'm relatively good at it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Oh...
[FI] She does have a great build.

[FI] She runs really fast, she's blessed with athletic 
genes indeed.
[FI] Possibly... even better than Kirino.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Do you have any sports you play in regularly?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] No, I don't have any interest in them.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I only do them as exercise, such as jogging.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hmm.

[FI] Since Saori seems to only like otaku-related stuff, 
this is how I interpreted her answer.

[FI] "I may have athletic talents, but... I don't really like it 
so it's meaningless"

[FI] She was thinking somewhere along those lines, 
that's my hunch.
[FI] What a waste.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] In that case, wanna do something together?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Eh? Do... what exactly?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Anything's fine. Tennis, even basketball.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] A variation of a typical date, that should be fine, 
right?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Hmmm... I'll think about it.

[FI] I figured this out recently, but you don't know if 
something is interesting until you try.

[FI] Just like my new interest in Otaku stuff, it'll be good 
if Saori could find the fun in something new.
[FI] And besides...
[FI] Being merry, playing sports together with Saori...
[FI] I can already picture her chest dancing around.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] By the way, Kyousuke-san, can you swim?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Not as well as someone from the swimming club, 
but I think I'm decently fast.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Do you want to race then?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, sure.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Hehe, things are heating up.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] Since it's rare for this to happen, wanna make a 
bet?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's fine, but is it over juice or something?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Of course not.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Let's see... If I lose, I'll give you a kiss.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Wha...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Fufufufu... What's the matter? Your face is all red.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...You little...
[FI] That's it, right there.

[FI] She's supposed to be super shy and yet, at times, 
she's incredibly bold.

[FI] What's with that? Did she contract a split 
personality as a side effect for acting differently?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Alright then...! I'll take that bet.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] That's the way.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Also, you can't go saying, "I can't, it's too 
embarrassing" afterwards.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] But of course.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Okay...! I'm gonna give it my all!!
